user.title: Biedronka
user.description: Choose how to sign in. Browser Companion is recommended; the manual auth code is an optional alternative that works in any browser.

menu_options.manual: Manual auth code (optional): sign in in your browser and paste the redirect

manual.title: Sign in to Moja Biedronka
manual.description:
1. On a computer, open this link: [konto.biedronka.pl]({auth_url})
2. Enter your phone number and solve the captcha. **Before entering the SMS code**, press F12 and open the **Console** tab.
3. Enter the SMS code. The page will not redirect anywhere — that is expected.
4. Copy the console line `Failed to launch 'app://cma20.biedronka.pl?code=…'` (or just the `app://…` address) and paste it below. If the console is empty, use the **Network** tab: the last request has a `Location: app://…` header.

The code expires after about a minute, so paste it right away. If it is rejected, sign in again with the same link.

companion.title: Browser Companion
companion.description:
Open Browser Companion in a new window:

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

Complete captcha, phone and SMS there. This screen waits for the app:// redirect.

companion_failed.title: Browser Companion
companion_failed.description:
Could not sign in with Browser Companion. Start the add-on, then submit to try again.

[{companion_url}]({companion_href})

error.companion_unavailable: Browser Companion did not capture the login. Start the add-on and try again.
error.invalid_code: The code is missing, expired or already used. Sign in again with the link and paste the new app:// address right away.

abort.already_configured: This loyalty card is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different loyalty card.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Signed in again. The integration has been reloaded.
